title: BIM Design Engineer - Wet Utilities
scope_summary: Egis is seeking a BIM Design Engineer specializing in Wet Utilities for infrastructure and building projects in the Middle East. The role involves leveraging BIM technology to design, coordinate, and optimize wet utilities systems, working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to ensure efficient project delivery and adherence to design standards. The position is based in Bengaluru, India, but is explicitly for projects in the Middle East.

title: Junior Electrical & Low Current Technical Office Engineer
scope_summary: Sisco Jobs, on behalf of Middle East Technical Solutions (METS), is looking for a Junior Electrical & Low Current Technical Office Engineer in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves supporting tendering, estimation, engineering, and execution activities, with a focus on reviewing tender documents, preparing shop drawings, and conducting various electrical calculations crucial to project success.

title: Program Director - Rail (including BIM framework and Master Information Delivery Plan)
scope_summary: Parsons is seeking a Program Director for a major rail program in the Middle East. This role involves leading a multidisciplinary consultancy team across all project stages, with a key responsibility to govern the project's BIM framework and Master Information Delivery Plan (MIDP) in line with PAS 1192. The Program Director will also lead tender preparation for the Design & Construct contract.
